name: Paper folding and hole punching
definition: Fold a sheet, punch a hole, unfold: each fold doubles the holes and places them as mirror images across the fold line. Working backwards fold by fold, in the reverse order of the folding, is the only reliable method.
recognizeWhen: the paper is folded twice and then punched
what does the sheet look like when unfolded
a hole is cut through all the layers
the corner is folded over before cutting
misconceptions: I unfolded all the folds at once instead of one at a time in reverse order.
I doubled the number of holes but put them in the wrong places.
I forgot that a hole on the fold line does not double.
